name: Doha
summary: Doha combines futuristic skyscrapers, a Persian Gulf coastline and one of the lowest crime rates in the world, with zero income tax and world-class digital infrastructure. In return, the digital nomad finds a high cost of living by regional standards, extreme heat between May and September, and a still small and underdeveloped community of nomads.
strengths: High quality of life8.7/10, above average (6.9/10)
